name: chess-coach
description: Chess coaching that you can tailor for yourself

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:api
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:api
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd apps/api && npx prisma db seed
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:api
